prompt: Run the smart money report for Q1 2026 (Jan 1 - Mar 31)
expected_output: All-trackers run with --date-range 2026-01-01,2026-03-31, produces convergence signals section

assertions.name: uses_date_range_filter
assertions.description: Output must use or reference date-range filter for Q1 2026
assertions.check: output contains '2026-01-01' or '2026-03-31' or 'Q1 2026' or 'Q1' or 'Jan' or 'Mar' or 'date-range'

assertions.name: includes_convergence_signals
assertions.description: Output must reference or produce convergence signals (the value-add section)
assertions.check: output contains 'convergence' or 'overlap' or 'cross-signal' or 'whale + congress' (case-insensitive)

assertions.name: report_file_produced
assertions.description: Output must reference a generated report file path or name
assertions.check: output contains 'reports/' or 'smart-money-2026' or '.md' file reference or 'report' or 'saved'

assertions.name: all_three_trackers_referenced
assertions.description: Output must reference or invoke 13F, Congress, and House Reps (the 3 trackers)
assertions.check: output contains '13F' AND ('congress' or 'STOCK Act') AND ('house' or 'House Reps' or 'clerk')
